description: Auto-fix: a chat's host following the pull request of the chat's branch and sending the chat what needs fixing (a failing check, a merge conflict, a new comment). Its toggle on the Git page (Baude's and the Android app's), its sender's name, the message it sends and why it can't be turned on.

messages.title: Auto-fix
messages.tip: Follow this pull request: a failing check, a merge conflict or a new comment is sent to this chat
messages.ask: Fix what it asks for, push the fix, and answer the comments that need an answer.
messages.no_branch: This chat's folder isn't on a branch
messages.not_github: This chat's folder isn't a GitHub repository
messages.no_pr: Branch {$branch} has no open pull request
messages.not_desktop: Auto-fix isn't offered for Claude Desktop chats
